verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud is described as the hosted SaaS version of the open-source product. The open-source server can run on any server through Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, DEB/RPM, binaries, Terraform or Docker Swarm. It includes Raft-based high availability and optional GPU support, and the vendor explicitly offers the 'freedom to self-host'. A community user also reports running it in Docker Compose. Missing for 10: an explicit feature-parity statement or matrix between self-hosted and Cloud, and evidence that Cloud-side offerings (Search Delivery Network, Cloud MCP server for cluster management) can be self-hosted.
